# Security

EVO PTT is a commercial product operated by **Evolvium Solutions Ltd**.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public GitHub issue for security reports.

Email **info@evoptt.com** with:

- A short description of the issue
- Steps to reproduce (if applicable)
- Impact assessment (if known)

We aim to acknowledge reports within **2 business days**.

## Scope note

This public repository is a marketing showcase and an open-source sample of an
earlier Android client foundation. It is not the current production deployment.
Production security reports should reference the live product at
[evoptt.com](https://evoptt.com) or the Google Play listing.
